newsitem.title: FRANCE: French presidency denies reshuffle report.
newsitem.headline: French presidency denies reshuffle report.

text.p: President Jacques Chirac's office denied on Monday a report in left-wing daily Liberation that he was planning a possible cabinet reshuffle to regain the political initiative.
"A reshuffle is not topical and has no basis. These rumours are just pure speculation," presidential spokeswoman Catherine Colonna said in response to questions on the newspaper report.
Chirac ruled out a reshuffle in a December 12 television broadcast after persistent reports that Prime Minister Alain Juppe was pressing for a cabinet shake-up.
